mapper.select:
select yea.*,pre.p_name as pName, pre.p_Region as pRegion, pre.P_Construction_Unit as pConstructionUnit, pre.P_Project_Stage as ProjectStage, pre.p_Project_Status as pProjectStatus, pre.p_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget from project_preset_year yea left join pre_project pre on yea.p_id = pre.p_id
1=1
and likePname(#{request.pName},pre.P_Id)=true
and pre.p_name like concat('%',#{request.pName},'%')
and yea.Py_Eclare_Year = #{request.pyEclareYear}
